{{Quote|My superior, Colonel Sartius, is an incompetent fool. I toil in his shadow, though his job should rightfully be mine.|Lieutenant Major [[Pirrell]]|<ref name="TOR:PA" />}}
'''Sartius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What's most infuriating is that Colonel Sartius has the full confidence of Admiral Ivernus. Colonel Sartius remains in power because he excels at hiding his gross incompetence from the admiral. But we're going to tear down that facade.|Lieutenant Major [[Pirrell]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:PA" />}}
During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]], Sartius served as naval attaché to the Imperial governor of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR:PA" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Lieutenant Major]] [[Pirrell]] attempted to take Sartius's place by having an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] cause many mishaps on Sartius's important missions.<ref name="TOR:PA" /> Although Sartius was placed under arrest, Pirrell's plan backfired, as Admiral [[Ivernus]] personally came down to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to [[Death/Legends|execute]] him. Little did Pirrell know, however, was that his [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was secretly in the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]] and their target was Ivernus himself. As Ivernus came out of his ship, the hunter attacked and killed him, as well as Pirell's [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] servant, [[Murghir]], who was revealed to be the other hunter attempting to kill Ivernus.<ref name="TOR:MtA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Meeting the Admiral|Balmorra}}</ref>
